source.scope: one authenticated local Codex CLI environment

capability_source.scope: ChatGPT Work and Codex model-selection guidance

fallback_use.recommendation_scope: recognized OpenAI surfaces listed by the official capability source
fallback_use.availability_scope: the observed Codex CLI environment only

reasoning_guidance.principle: Use the lowest reasoning effort that reliably meets the task's quality and validation requirements.
reasoning_guidance.medium: Tasks needing more planning while balancing speed and depth.
reasoning_guidance.high: Difficult work with multiple steps, sources, or tradeoffs.
reasoning_guidance.xhigh: Difficult work needing more sustained analysis and checking than high.
reasoning_guidance.max: The hardest single-task problems when depth matters more than speed or usage.
reasoning_guidance.ultra: Large complex work that can be split into meaningful parallel subtasks using automatic delegation.

models.runtime_description: Our most capable model for complex, demanding work.
models.official_description: Most capable model for complex work across code, apps, and research, with advanced reasoning, computer use, and stronger judgment.
models.selection_guidance: Use for the hardest end-to-end workflows across multiple steps and tools that require sustained reasoning and judgment.

models.runtime_description: Reliable agentic workhorse for everyday tasks.
models.official_description: Most capable GPT-5.6 model for complex coding, computer use, research, and cybersecurity.
models.selection_guidance: Use for complex, open-ended, ambiguous, difficult, or high-value work that needs extra analysis, judgment, or polish.

models.runtime_description: Balanced agentic coding model for everyday work.
models.official_description: Balanced GPT-5.6 model for everyday work, competitive with GPT-5.5 at a lower cost.
models.selection_guidance: Use for everyday work needing strong reasoning and tool use when Sol's full depth is unnecessary.

models.runtime_description: Fast and affordable agentic coding model.
models.official_description: Fast and affordable GPT-5.6 model with strong capability at the lowest cost in the family.
models.selection_guidance: Use for clear, repeatable, specific, or high-volume extraction, classification, transformation, and structured-summary tasks.

models.runtime_description: Proven previous-generation model for coding and general work.
models.official_description: Previous-generation flagship model for complex coding, computer use, knowledge work, and research workflows.
models.selection_guidance: Use only when it is available and compatibility with previous-generation workflows matters; prefer a current recommended family for new routing decisions.

models.official_description: Text-only research preview optimized for near-instant, real-time coding iteration and available to eligible ChatGPT Pro users.
models.selection_guidance: Use for rapid, text-only coding iteration when its preview status and account availability are acceptable.
